titulo: Member of British armed forces killed in Ukraine crash, says MoD
cuerpo: Ministry of Defence says person, who has yet to be identified, died in road traffic incident not believed to be result of hostile action A member of the UK armed forces has been killed in a crash in Ukraine, the Ministry of Defence said. The person, who has not yet been named, died in a road traffic incident on Saturday. It is understood the incident was not a result of hostile action. Continue reading...
